Candidate A: an elongated flattened peach caterpillar with FOUR soft low oval body segments and a tiny blunt rounded tail; very short lavender proleg nubs; just two small lavender patches on its back, no busy spots. A lazy sagging posture with belly close to ground; it looks barely capable of moving. This is the simplest, cheapest-looking baseline enemy.
